cases.question: revenue compounded at over 20% a year over 3 years (CAGR)
tool_calls: find_fspattern('compounded at a rate per year') -> compound_growth
cases.evidence_check: matched.fundamental.revenue = {kind:growth, value:1.0005, window:'3y_cagr'}. Has value+window BUT MISSING years_checked AND MISSING requested_n. No series (CAGR is a single stat, so series-absence is fine).
cases.confusion_note: None on selection (compound_growth is the CAGR hit; 20% -> 0.20). But the evidence block is thinner than every sibling window pattern.
cases.reason: Correct match/result, but the evidence shape is NON-UNIFORM: compound_growth omits years_checked (present on all 8 other window patterns) so the caller can't confirm the CAGR was measured over the requested N=3 from the evidence alone.

defects.desc: compound_growth (CAGR) matched.fundamental lacks `years_checked` and `requested_n` — only value + window:'3y_cagr'. The N is only inferable from the window string '3y_cagr'. Add years_checked (and requested_n) for uniformity/auditability.
